en.title: Mélenchon launches 2027 presidential campaign with wage and retirement pledges
en.dek: Jean-Luc Mélenchon presented his 2027 manifesto at Le Bourget, pledging a higher minimum wage and retirement at age 60.
facts: Jean-Luc Mélenchon launched his 2027 presidential campaign on 7 November.
He presented his manifesto at Le Bourget, north of Paris.
The manifesto is titled "A Shared Future".
Mélenchon pledged to raise France's minimum wage.
He pledged to restore the retirement age to 60.
Die Zeit reported he presented his program as a presidential candidate.
body: Jean-Luc Mélenchon presented his presidential manifesto at Le Bourget, north of Paris, on 7 November, and France 24 reported the document is titled "A Shared Future". Die Zeit reported he presented his program as a candidate for the presidential election.

The manifesto pledges to raise France's minimum wage, and it pledges to restore the retirement age to 60. France 24 and The Straits Times reported these measures ahead of the event. The Straits Times reported the retirement pledge would set the age at 60.

France 24 reported Mélenchon launched his campaign at the Le Bourget venue, and the outlet said he is running in the 2027 presidential election. The Straits Times reported the pledges before the manifesto presentation. The event took place north of Paris.

The Straits Times reported the minimum wage pledge alongside the retirement plan, and France 24 reported he vowed to lower the retirement age at the campaign launch. Both outlets confirmed the two core economic pledges. The Straits Times said the retirement age would return to 60.

Die Zeit covered the manifesto presentation as part of the 2027 race, and the outlet reported Mélenchon presented his program as a candidate. France 24 said the manifesto title is "A Shared Future". The presentation took place ahead of the 2027 presidential election.

The campaign launch took place on 7 November, and the manifesto presentation occurred at Le Bourget. France 24 reported the event ahead of the 2027 presidential race. The Straits Times reported the pledges on the same day.
en.context: Jean-Luc Mélenchon is a candidate in the 2027 French presidential election. France 24 identified him with the France Unbowed party. He presented his manifesto at Le Bourget, north of Paris.

en.headline: Mélenchon presents presidential manifesto ahead of 2027 race
en.body: Jean-Luc Mélenchon presented his presidential manifesto at Le Bourget, north of Paris, according to France 24. Die Zeit reported that he presented his program as a candidate for the presidential election. France 24 said the manifesto is titled "A Shared Future".

es.headline: Mélenchon presenta su manifiesto presidencial de cara a la carrera electoral de 2027
es.body: Jean-Luc Mélenchon presentó su manifiesto presidencial en Le Bourget, al norte de París, según France 24. Die Zeit informó de que presentó su programa como candidato a la elección presidencial. France 24 dijo que el manifiesto se titula «Un futuro compartido».

it.headline: Mélenchon presenta il manifesto presidenziale in vista delle elezioni del 2027
it.body: Jean-Luc Mélenchon ha presentato il suo manifesto presidenziale al Le Bourget, a nord di Parigi, secondo France 24. Die Zeit ha riportato che ha presentato il suo programma in qualità di candidato alle elezioni presidenziali. France 24 ha riferito che il manifesto è intitolato «Un futuro condiviso».

fr.headline: Mélenchon présente son manifeste présidentiel à l’approche de l’élection de 2027
fr.body: Jean-Luc Mélenchon a présenté son manifeste présidentiel au Bourget, au nord de Paris, selon France 24. Die Zeit a rapporté qu’il a présenté son programme en tant que candidat à l’élection présidentielle. France 24 a indiqué que le manifeste est intitulé « Un avenir partagé ».

de.headline: Mélenchon stellt Präsidentschaftsprogramm im Vorfeld der Wahl 2027 vor
de.body: Jean-Luc Mélenchon stellte laut France 24 sein Präsidentschaftsprogramm in Le Bourget nördlich von Paris vor. Die Zeit berichtete, er habe als Kandidat für die Präsidentschaftswahl sein Programm präsentiert. France 24 erklärte, das Manifest trage den Titel „Eine gemeinsame Zukunft“.

zh.headline: 梅朗雄在2027年总统大选前发布总统竞选纲领
zh.body: 据法国24报道，让-吕克·梅朗雄在巴黎北部的勒布尔热公布了他的总统竞选纲领。德国《时代周报》报道称，他以总统选举候选人的身份公布了自己的竞选纲领。法国24表示，该纲领题为《共同的未来》。

ja.headline: メランション氏、2027年大統領選を前に大統領選公約を発表
ja.body: フランス24によると、ジャン＝リュック・メランション氏はパリ北方のル・ブルジェで大統領選公約を発表した。ディー・ツァイトは、同氏が大統領選候補として政綱を提示したと報じた。フランス24によると、この公約のタイトルは「A Shared Future」である。

ko.headline: 멜랑숑, 2027년 대선 앞두고 대선 공약집 발표
ko.body: 프랑스 24에 따르면 장뤼크 멜랑숑이 파리 북부 르부르제에서 대선 공약집을 발표했다. 디 차이트는 그가 대통령 선거 후보로서 자신의 정강을 발표했다고 전했다. 프랑스 24는 이 공약집의 제목이 "A Shared Future"라고 밝혔다.

pt.headline: Mélenchon apresenta manifesto presidencial antes da corrida de 2027
pt.body: Jean-Luc Mélenchon apresentou o seu manifesto presidencial em Le Bourget, no norte de Paris, segundo a France 24. O Die Zeit noticiou que apresentou o seu programa como candidato à eleição presidencial. A France 24 afirmou que o manifesto se intitula "Um Futuro Partilhado".
